title: Subprocess wrapper with a fake runner
hints: First turn cmd into a list: shlex.split(cmd) if it is a str, else list(cmd). Check for emptiness before calling runner.
runner(argv, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout) returns an object with .returncode, .stdout, .stderr; build CommandResult from those.
Wrap the runner call in try/except subprocess.TimeoutExpired and raise CommandError(...) from it; after the call, if check and returncode != 0 raise CommandError with returncode and stderr.
query_osquery is two lines: run_command(["osqueryi", "--json", sql], runner=runner).stdout, then json.loads unless it is blank.
